mentions.note: 18-year-old A.A.A. Junior mile champion, guest in 880 yds; Scotsman

mentions.note: becoming first claim Belgrave after 14 months; first claim Victoria Park AAC in Scotland; holds British Junior mile record
two memorable runs for Belgrave in October 1965; pictured in the club road relay
21 year old Scotsman; first road relay for Belgrave; stage 11, 24:45 (printed W.Barrow in times)
5th leg, two seconds outside previous stage best
certain not to run in the National
